Server-to-server webhook. Paystack signs the raw body with HMAC-SHA512 using the secret key; the signature is sent in the `x-paystack-signature` header and validated. Handles `charge.success` and `charge.failed`. Returns HTTP 200 on success, 403 on invalid signature. Not called by clients.
